title.narrative: Provision of knowledge to support better informed social, employment and work-related policies in the Western Balkans and Türkiye

description.narrative: The primary objective of this Action is to strengthen evidence-based policy making in the beneficiary countries for the improvement of living and working conditions as part of their commitment to the principles of the European pillar of social rights. The first specific objective is to provide access -based on sound survey methods- to original data on living and working conditions with a focus on specific populations and economic sectors. The secondary specific objective is to provide a comparative perspective between countries in the region as well as with EU27 on the basis of sound statistical analysis and expert consultation on the national policy context. The third specific objective is to expand expert networks through participation of representatives from governments, trade union and employer organisations from the beneficiaries in selected meetings organised Eurofound.
